Name: Replace Demetrius with Doc Brown
Author: KonaKona7
Description:
Portrait art borrowed and edited from:
http://canvas.pantone.com/gallery/83661265/PixelArt-Vol-IV-Back-to-the-Future

Pairs well with my other mod that replaces Sebastian with Marty McFly:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6627]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6627[/url]

Does not change names or dialogue or anything besides graphics. If anyone wants to make those, feel free to do so with my blessing.

UPDATE 1.1
Doc's sprite no longer does mundane things like reading a book and taking notes. Now he does proper mad scientist things.
Added darker edge around portrait.

Future ideas:
